entities.name: Lothar
entities.description: The Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's mentor on Innistrad; leader of an elite group of protectors; died by plunging from a Thraben wall.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Young cathar recruited by Lothar who became Guardian of Thraben after his death.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: Sibling necromancer who, with Gisa, orchestrated the Siege of Thraben.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: Sibling necromancer who, with Geralf, orchestrated the Siege of Thraben.

entities.name: Siege of Thraben
entities.description: Catastrophic undead assault on Thraben during which Lothar died.

events.summary: Lothar recruits Thalia after witnessing her brave and selfless actions on the battlefield.
events.quote: a promising young cathar whom he recruited after witnessing her brave and selfless actions on the battlefield

events.summary: Geralf and Gisa Cecani unleash a horde of undead on Thraben in the Siege of Thraben.
events.quote: unleashed a massive horde of undead upon the city

events.summary: Tormented by demonic voices, Lothar plunges from a Thraben wall to his death.
events.quote: leading him to tragically plunge off one of Thraben's high walls to his death

events.summary: Thalia becomes Guardian of Thraben in Lothar's stead.
events.quote: thrusting his protégé, Thalia, into the position of Guardian of Thraben in his stead

relations.quote: Lothar was the Guardian of Thraben , and Thalia 's mentor on the plane of Innistrad .
the sibling necromancers Geralf and Gisa Cecani
